title: Account portfolio signal compressor and lightweight scoping proxy for CS intake
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Goal: Build a lightweight middle-layer that ingests Sales/CS feature asks, groups semantically-similar signals across customer portfolios, and produces a templated 'initial scoping proxy' for PMs and Engineers to evaluate quickly.

Why: Sales and CS submit high-volume, overlapping asks that currently create duplicate scoping work. We want a repeatable consolidation step that preserves account-level constraints (regulatory, SLA) while reducing manual triage time and surfacing high-leverage, cross-account opportunities.

Scope: prototype a compressor service + short scoping template. Inputs: CS intake form entries, account metadata (tier, region, compliance flags), and recent support threads. Outputs: grouped bundles (with representative summary), a one-paragraph impact/benefit statement, a 1-3 point complexity estimate, and recommended next-step (POC / design spike / deprioritize).

Out of scope: automated prioritization into roadmaps (this project only produces inputs for PM prioritization). No production RBAC or billing changes in phase 1.
acceptance_criteria: CSV/JSON export from prototype groups >= 70% precision on human-annotated consolidation sample (n=150 asks)
CS pilot (3 AE reps) can submit intake and receive a suggested group + scoping proxy within 24 hours in >80% of cases
PMs can convert a grouped bundle into a 1-page scoping brief in <20 minutes using the template
Audit trace: each grouped bundle preserves links to original asks and a list of affected accounts
comments: 2025-11-03 | Aisha Raman: Kickoff — interviewed 4 AE reps and 2 CS managers. Common pain: repeated scope work for similar asks (SAML SSO variants, VPC peering automations). Collected 120 historical intake rows for initial sample.

2025-11-05 | Marco Li: Spiked a two-step pipeline: (1) semantic hashing + similarity clustering; (2) template generator using a short rule-based extractor. Initial cluster precision 0.62 on 50-sample; acceptable as baseline. Spike code in repo ops-intake/spike/cluster-v1.
2025-11-07 | Emily Park (Sales lead): Reviewed initial UX. Requests: preserve customer priority flags and add 'strategic account' override so bundles do not hide single-account enterprise demands.

2025-11-08 | Marco Li: Updated clustering threshold and added account-level override. New cluster precision 0.72 on holdout 50-sample. Created quick CSV exporter for PM review. Linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-intake/pull/87

2025-11-10 | PM review session: Consensus to proceed with a 3-rep CS pilot and a PM-side conversion workshop. Decision to require a mandatory human confirmation step before merging bundles into PM backlog (avoid over-consolidation).
2025-11-12 | Aisha Raman: Ran pilot onboarding doc and scheduled pilot for 2025-11-17. Asked Eng to instrument a "source of truth" link in every bundle so audit can reconstruct original asks.
decisions: Include account-level metadata in grouping (tier, region, compliance) — prevents inappropriate consolidation across incompatible accounts
Require human confirmation by a CS rep or PM before a grouped bundle is considered for prioritization (safety net against over-compression)
Start with a rule-based template for scoping proxy (impact, rough complexity, privacy/regulatory notes) and iterate toward an ML summarizer after pilot feedback
tradeoffs: Aggressive consolidation reduces duplicate scoping work but risks hiding customer-unique constraints — mitigated via account flags and mandatory confirmation
Rule-based templates are faster to ship but produce lower-quality language than an ML summarizer; chosen to minimize initial review burden
Pilot limited to 3 AE reps reduces rollout risk but may not capture edge-case vertical-specific asks
follow_up_tasks: ENG-4120: Add 'source_of_truth' field to bundle export (link back to original intake rows and conversations)
PM-314159: Run conversion workshop with PMs to validate template - schedule 2025-11-20
Design-79: Create quick acknowledgement CTA in CS intake UI for reps to confirm suggested bundle
Ops: Recruit 3 AE reps and 1 CS manager for pilot; prepare pilot metrics dashboard
